name: Knit Beanie Mockup
summary: PSD beanie mockup on a model with headphones, with Smart Objects for crown artwork and cuff label.
description: A knit beanie mockup framed from behind on a model holding over-ear headphones, with a rubber label patch on the folded cuff and jacquard artwork knitted across the crown. The 135.1 MB PSD (4500x3000 px, 300 dpi) uses two Smart Objects for the crown artwork and the cuff label, has editable knit color and organized layers, and is made for Adobe Photoshop. Personal use is free; extended use needs the Pro license.
